answer: Walnut Oasis Delta Well Registry: each identity funds one real USGS groundwater monitoring well in a walnut-grove oasis, paying $145 a year for its telemetry. USGS publishes the well's monthly water-level delta; the registry checks each reading against the well's own history, so a farm reusing one well across many identities fails the one-well-one-identity lookup, and a silent well is struck. Real constraint: wells are finite per delta, so the registry caps identities per aquifer.
